github.short_description: Shipped work, hours saved against Chinwag’s published tier model, and recorded credits. Pipeline work stays at 0 hours saved.

dora_baseline_explainer.heading: How baseline time is estimated
dora_baseline_explainer.plain_english: Baseline Hours is Chinwag’s estimate of active human engineering time for a change this size. Compare it with Chinwag Cycle Time after the change ships.
dora_baseline_explainer.source_attribution: This is a Chinwag planning model informed by DORA software delivery research and LinearB engineering benchmarks. The S/M/L/XL hour values are Chinwag estimates, not a tier table published or endorsed by DORA or LinearB.
dora_baseline_explainer.time_basis: Active engineering hours. Calendar waiting time is excluded from the hours-saved calculation.
dora_baseline_explainer.realized_hours_rule: Net Hours Saved stays 0 while work is open, scoped, running, or awaiting review. After verified shipment with a completion timestamp and receipt, it is max(0, Baseline Hours − actual elapsed hours).
dora_baseline_explainer.tier_lock_rule: The final changed-line count caps the scoped tier; a smaller delivered change uses the smaller baseline.

zero_empty_column_invariant.rule: A field may be listed in visible_fields only when every item in that view’s filter has a real, non-empty value. Numeric zero is populated; missing evidence is not zero.
zero_empty_column_invariant.on_failure: Omit the field from visibleFieldIds before publishing the view. Do not invent values or insert em dashes.
zero_empty_column_invariant.preflight: Check every filtered row before creating or updating a view. Keep optional fields hidden until every visible row has a value.

security_invariants.INV-BOARD-ZERO-LEAK-01: Private by default. Repository and workspace access controls protect confidential issues; public exports require explicit opt-in and H_board redaction.
security_invariants.INV-NO-DRAFT-ISSUES-01: Use repository-backed issues so repository access controls apply.
security_invariants.INV-HONEST-REALIZED-HOURS-01: Hours saved are 0 until verified shipment, a real completion timestamp, and a verification receipt exist.

github.confidential_seat_policy: Confidential work is always routed to private repositories. Public showcase mode requires explicit opt-in and redaction.

surface_impact_gate.ci_pillar: Pillar 12 · chinwag-ci surface-gate + Pillar 9 · chinwag-ci ui-gate
surface_impact_gate.receipt_rule: Record only checks that ran. Say when a surface does not apply. Reopen the card if a required check fails.
